quarries.title: Old Scar, the Great Boar
quarries.text: A boar the size of a cart, its hide a map of every spear that failed.

quarries.title: The Tusked Mountain
quarries.text: The herd follows it, and the herd tramples villages.

quarries.title: Kesh, the Striped Blade
quarries.text: A beastfolk duelist who collects the swords of the knights he kills.

quarries.title: The White Tyrant
quarries.text: It drives its herd down the passes every winter, and the passes close behind it.

quarries.title: Sir Rime, the Iceborn
quarries.text: A knight who froze on watch a century ago, and never stopped standing it.

quarries.title: Frostmaw
quarries.text: A white dragon that sleeps under the glacier and wakes hungry.

quarries.title: Gorrh, Fist of the Pit
quarries.text: The demon army's champion, who fights for the joy of it.

quarries.title: The Ashen Beast
quarries.text: A beast of smoke and teeth that leads the Pit's hounds.

quarries.title: Lilu, Daughter of the Pit
quarries.text: Heir to a throne of fire, and in no hurry to inherit it.

quarries.title: Red Garrick, the Highway King
quarries.text: He robs the caravans in the old King's name, and keeps the King's share.

quarries.title: Captain Vell, Who Opened the Gate
quarries.text: The captain who let the otherworld in, and was paid for it.

quarries.title: Brother Ash, the Zealot
quarries.text: He burns villages to save them, and has saved a great many.

quarries.title: The Storm That Flies
quarries.text: Where it nests, it has not stopped raining in forty years.

quarries.title: The Hollow Paladin
quarries.text: An empty suit of armor still keeping its temple from the faithful.

quarries.title: The One Who Shakes the Earth
quarries.text: A Divine Beast that has forgotten whom it was set to guard.

quarries.title: Ironjaw, the Crag Wyrm
quarries.text: A red dragon whose lair is paved with the shields of those who came for it.

quarries.title: Brom One-Eye
quarries.text: A giant who keeps the dragons' cattle, and eats their thieves.

quarries.title: Nightwing, the Black Wyrm
quarries.text: A wyrm that hunts by night and is never seen until it has chosen.
